# observe_server_monitor (Resource)

A server monitor: open and closed ports, ping, heartbeat, SSL on a port and a health URL.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "observe_server_monitor" "web1" {
  name                  = "web-1"
  host                  = "web-1.example.com"
  ports_expected_open   = [22, 443]
  ports_expected_closed = [3306]
  ping_enabled          = true
  heartbeat_enabled     = true
  ssl_check_enabled     = true
  ssl_check_port        = 443
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `full_port_scan_enabled` (Boolean)
- `health_check_enabled` (Boolean)
- `health_check_expected_code` (Number)
- `health_check_expected_string` (String)
- `health_check_url` (String)
- `heartbeat_enabled` (Boolean)
- `heartbeat_grace_minutes` (Number)
- `heartbeat_interval_minutes` (Number)
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID; defaults to the provider's `organization_id`
- `ping_acceptable_loss_pct` (Number)
- `ping_enabled` (Boolean)
- `ping_max_hops` (Number)
- `ping_packet_count` (Number)
- `ping_packet_size` (Number)
- `port_expected_responses` (Map of String) Text each port must answer with, e.g. {"6379": "PONG"}
- `port_send_strings` (Map of String) Text to send per port, e.g. {"6379": "PING"}
- `ports_expected_closed` (List of Number) Ports that must refuse connections
- `ports_expected_open` (List of Number) Ports that must accept connections, e.g. [22, 443]
- `ssl_check_enabled` (Boolean)
- `ssl_check_port` (Number)
- `tags` (List of String)
- `team_id` (String) A team in this organization

### Read-Only

- `heartbeat_url` (String) POST to it from the server while the heartbeat is on
- `id` (String) ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization_id>/<id>, or <id> when the provider sets organization_id
terraform import observe_server_monitor.example 01JCX4ZK7N2Q8V3W5Y6A9B0C1D/01JCX5A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9J0K1
```
